column1: # Tag audit proposals — tranche 2: every 8th flag by code at offset 1 (32 of 254),
# the pilot having taken offset 0. Additions only; removals are their own round.
# HOW TO REVIEW: delete the rows you disagree with. What survives is applied.
# Nothing else to fill in; the deletions are themselves the record of your call.
# The pull request shows each flag's image beside its row.
# Then say so, and the agent runs scripts/apply-tag-audit.mjs, the validators and
# the Playwright suite. Do not edit proposals.original.tsv — the difference
# between it and this file is how your rejections get remembered.
# Read the name; the code beside it is what the script applies to, and a row whose
# name and code disagree is refused. To see a flag: https://flagfilter.com/?q=<name>
# Columns: name, code, tag, add|remove, confidence, why.

column6: The broken trident head is black.
The arms are on a heraldic shield: fleurs-de-lis, a Maltese cross and three crowns.
The ribbon reads OUANALAO, which the flag's own symbolism calls the local name of the island.
Two sailing ships cross the seas in the arms.
A sun rises on the left horizon of the arms.
The central star sits on a closed red disc.
The double-headed eagle is on a red shield, with a second shield on its breast.
The conch, lobster and cactus are on a yellow shield.
The crescent and the five stars are white.
The arc of eight stars is white.
